2. Daily Summary
I visited the NCISD New Operations Building job site in New Caney, TX, where Gamma Construction is the general contractor. YSD framers continued installing metal track. One framer installed metal track from a scissor lift using a powder-actuated tool and was 100% tied off at all times. Workers used the chop saw to cut metal framing to the desired size, and I documented a framer holding metal pieces cut to size. The foreman and his helper did line work, and a Baker scaffold was used to hold the plans. I also documented a wall the framers are building with metal track.
3. Safety Measures Verified
Fall Protection
The framer operating the scissor lift was 100% tied off at all times.
Scissor Lift
Framer installed metal track from a scissor lift; the tie-off point on the platform was documented.
PPE
Hard hats, high-visibility vests, and gloves documented on workers; face shields documented at the chop saw.
Fire Extinguishers
Fire extinguisher documented on the scissor lift platform and near the cutting station.
Cutting Station
Workers cut metal framing to size at the chop saw.
Plans & Layout
Baker scaffold used to hold the plans; foreman and helper completed line work.
